scope.method: Read-only current Ghidra reference enumeration for five sinks plus692570; every direct call exact-address decompiled statement plus original bytes. One-level incoming references to containers and named dependencies. All computed calls within those functions. Separate whole-program immediate-displacement slot400 call scan.
limitations: Ghidra-defined instructions/functions/reference database, not an independent raw executable exhaustiveness proof.
Five sinks are a declared audit boundary, not proof that every alternate constructor or indirect bridge has been discovered.
Computed call register provenance and receiver types are not globally solved; exact unresolved sites are retained instead of a universal claim.
A vtable data reference is not itself a callsite or a new gameplay producer.
Historical53 includes bridges, continuations, missile and Captain code; it is not53 independent player commands.
Covered function classification means its named bounded evidence only; it does not establish every path through the container.
Argument expressions may contain decompiler typing artifacts; original call bytes and assembly context are retained.
